rappel_detail.anchor: natural anchor at the end of the SE Shelf
rappel_detail.station: The end of the SE Shelf, reached after one roped pitch of low 5th-class downclimbing to gain the ledge system.
rappel_detail.notes: The standard rappel, back down to the glacier snowfield. Parties descending closer to the true summit sometimes make one more, off a ledge system roughly 400-500 ft below the top.
